glossEn: come to pass / happen, occur, or be the case in the course of events or by chance
note: come to pass / happen, occur, or be the case。**happen 本身含「非刻意」的意味**，这是它与 occur 的区别。线索：What happened? / happen to see。

glossEn: chance to be or do something, without intention or causation
note: chance to be or do something, without intention。**只用于 happen to + 原形**，不单独用。线索：happen to meet sb。
come into being; become reality。现有中文无此义项，属新增。线索：I hope it happens / the best case scenario。
